I locked soil_ph as the single hypothesis and ran the pre-registered confirmatory test on held-out data. The confirmatory OLS (outcome on soil_ph + site indicators) gave estimate 0.013, SE 0.121, p=0.911 — not significant. The exploratory association did not replicate, so no exposure has a confirmed direct effect on yield_kg after accounting for farm.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['soil_ph','yield_kg']).copy()
d['yc'] = d['yield_kg'] - d.groupby('farm')['yield_kg'].transform('mean')
d['ec'] = d['soil_ph'] - d.groupby('farm')['soil_ph'].transform('mean')
m = smf.ols('yc ~ ec - 1', data=d).fit()
print(m.summary())
# influence
infl = m.get_influence()
cooks = infl.cooks_distance[0]
print("max cook", cooks.max(), "at", d.index[cooks.argmax()])
# drop top 3 cooks
idx = np.argsort(cooks)[-3:]
d2 = d.drop(d.index[idx])
m2 = smf.ols('yc ~ ec - 1', data=d2).fit()
print("after drop3:", m2.params['ec'], m2.pvalues['ec'])
# robust
m3 = smf.ols('yc ~ ec - 1', data=d).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("HC3:", m3.params['ec'], m3.pvalues['ec'])

"}

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')

d['yc'] = d['yield_kg'] - d.groupby('farm')['yield_kg'].transform('mean')

m = smf.ols('yc ~ ec - 1', data=d).fit()
print(m.summary())
# influence
infl = m.get_influence()
cooks = infl.cooks_distance[0]
print("max cook", cooks.max(), "at", d.index[cooks.argmax()])
# drop top 3 cooks
idx = np.argsort(cooks)[-3:]
d2 = d.drop(d.index[idx])
m2 = smf.ols('yc ~ ec - 1', data=d2).fit()
print("after drop3:", m2.params['ec'], m2.pvalues['ec'])
# robust
m3 = smf.ols('yc ~ ec - 1', data=d).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("HC3:", m3.params['ec'], m3.pvalues['ec'])
"}
